enable_async_tasks.description: Enable the independent Pi background task bridge
enable_async_tasks.hint: When disabled, the legacy /pi and /pic session route remains available; no Pi background worker is created.

task_require_admin.description: Restrict Pi task tools to AstrBot administrators
task_require_admin.hint: When disabled, a caller can access only tasks owned by the current AstrBot conversation.

pi_provider_id.description: AstrBot provider used by Pi workers
pi_provider_id.hint: Leave empty to use the provider selected for the current chat. The initial bridge supports OpenAI-compatible providers only; provider keys are passed only to the worker environment.

pi_model.hint: Leave empty to use the selected AstrBot provider's active model.

pi_executable.hint: Provide one executable path only. Leave empty to prefer the plugin-owned Node 22.19.0 and Pi 0.84.2 runtime, then fall back to pi on PATH. This is not a task timeout setting.

pi_session_dir.description: Optional native Pi session directory for the legacy /pi route
pi_session_dir.hint: Background tasks always receive their own isolated Pi session and workspace.

state_directory.hint: Leave empty to use the plugin .pi directory. Contains the SQLite WAL registry, plugin-managed task sessions, per-task agent configuration, default workspaces, and artifact metadata.

workspace_root.hint: Leave empty to use state_directory/workspaces. Each pi_agent task receives a distinct subdirectory.

poll_interval_seconds.hint: This affects the observer only. Pi work is never stopped because an observation cycle is slow or empty.

no_meaningful_event_limit.hint: Meaningful output, tool transitions, status changes, and new artifacts reset the counter. The worker is retained when the limit is reached.

session_retention_hours.description: Retention period for terminal task metadata and managed artifacts
session_retention_hours.hint: Only completed, failed, and cancelled tasks are eligible for retention cleanup. Running, paused, and orphaned tasks are retained.

max_concurrent_tasks.description: Maximum independent Pi workers running at once
max_concurrent_tasks.hint: Each task has an isolated Pi process and session. This limit does not block normal AstrBot chat turns.

command_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for Pi RPC control acknowledgements only
command_timeout_seconds.hint: This is not a hard task timeout and not an idle timeout. It bounds the observer's get_state request and short steer, cancel, and resume acknowledgements. pi_task_poll reads local buffered events and the latest durable snapshot without waiting for Pi.

inherit_persona.description: Copy the current AstrBot persona into new Pi tasks
inherit_persona.hint: The persona plus the current event's public fields and source message are copied at creation time. Later chat messages are not synchronized automatically; use pi_task_follow_up to add requirements.

media_capture_timeout_seconds.description: Timeout for copying one event media component into a task workspace
media_capture_timeout_seconds.hint: This only bounds media preparation at task creation. It is not a Pi task timeout; failed conversion is returned as a capture warning.

pi_skill_paths.hint: Each existing path is passed to the task worker as a repeated public Pi CLI --skill argument. Passing a path does not guarantee that Pi loaded the Skill; inspect the task snapshot or result for runtime evidence.

pi_mcp_config_paths.description: External Pi extension or MCP configuration paths
pi_mcp_config_paths.hint: Current capability boundary: any non-empty value returns a structured unsupported-capability envelope from pi_agent. The bridge does not pass these paths to Pi and never imports AstrBot MCP servers automatically.
